chunks: And whatever is in it from Yusuf ibn Ya'qub, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah have mercy on him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Yusuf ibn Ya'qub, the brother of Yunus ibn Ya'qub, and they were both Faṭhis.

key_terms.سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ: Sa'd ibn Abdullah al-Qummi, a prominent narrator
key_terms.فَطْحِيَّيْنِ: Two individuals belonging to the tribe of Fath or having that lineage status
key_terms.يُوسُفَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ: Yusuf ibn Ya'qub, a key narrator in Shia hadith literature

ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator chain for Yusuf ibn Ya'qub in this hadith?
ai.summary: Shia Islamic scholar enriching hadith summaries with historical and scholarly context.
